SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CARING FOR WATER ENVIRONMENT
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Caring for water environment helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS ABOUT WATER
We use water for drinking, cooking, cleaning, and farming.
Conserve water: close taps, fix leaks, reuse grey water for plants where safe.
Unsafe water can cause disease — store drinking water in clean covered containers.

PART 1: Identify ways of using sparingly water sparingly to reduce  In groups, learners to demonstrate the wastage different practices of careful use of

What this means
In this part you learn to identify ways of using sparingly water sparingly to reduce  In groups, learners to demonstrate the wastage different practices of careful use of. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify ways of using sparingly water sparingly to reduce  In groups, learners to demonstrate the wastage different practices of careful use of.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Caring for water environment” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify ways of using sparingly water sparingly to reduce  In groups, learners to demonstrate the wastage different practices of careful use of. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use water sparingly at water home and school  Learners to identify common

What this means
In this part you learn to use water sparingly at water home and school  Learners to identify common. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use water sparingly at water home and school  Learners to identify common.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Caring for water environment matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use water sparingly at water home and school  Learners to identify common. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Caring for water environment is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Conserve water: close taps, fix leaks, reuse grey water for plants where safe.

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Caring for water environment” around your school. (skill: identify ways of using sparingly water sparingly to reduce  In groups, learners to demonstrate the wastage different practices of careful use of)

Example 2: Say why Caring for water environment matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: use water sparingly at water home and school  Learners to identify common)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Caring for water environment to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify ways of using sparingly water sparingly to reduce  In groups, learners to demonstrate the wastage different practices of careful use of.
3. Practise this skill: use water sparingly at water home and school  Learners to identify common.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Caring for water environment from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Caring for water environment: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Caring for water environment?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

1. Know what Caring for water environment means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
